axes.name: Material original obligations and negative constraints
axes.evidence: All O01–O05 and N01–N03 examined against complete final and original brief. Unknown product parameters remain explicit owner decisions.

axes.name: Consequential source facts, governing conditions, versions and applicability
axes.evidence: Consequential standards/API/default/version/history claims checked against independent primary context. See per-source families and defect records.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, alternatives and implementation/failure history
axes.evidence: Materially different maintained approaches and decoding/CMM/scaling/privacy/resource opportunities examined; no citation-count or universal-recall score.

axes.name: Valid corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.evidence: Every significant plan clause and every criticism examined; available primary context, rather than critic agreement, governs the judgment.

axes.name: Supported meaning retained from draft and criticism into the complete final
axes.evidence: Supported draft/discovery meaning traced into final by grouped obligation and criticism. Wording/ID duplication is not semantic preservation.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed validation, with executed work distinguished
axes.evidence: Domains, expected observations and proposed oracles examined. Both arms claim desk research only; no future execution or deployment demanded.

obligations.text: Non-destructive inspection, thumbnails/review copies and selective export
Orientation, color profiles, scaling, transparency and visual consistency
Derivative regeneration provenance across policy and decoder changes
Distinct internal/external metadata policies and identifying-data limits
Bounded resources, mixed batch failures, unsupported inputs and cancellation with alternatives

negative_constraints.text: No originals overwrite or contributor upload
No dimension-only fidelity claim or plausible-image substitution after failed decode

source_families.limits: No installed decoder or user images tested.

source_families.family: ICC, transfer/alpha, sample precision and output profiles
source_families.limits: Finite source claims assessed; arbitrary CMM/profile correctness not proved.
Core claimed mechanisms assessed through specifications and maintainer/code context; full Exif 3.1 normative tag schema not analyzed.
Claims and support gates assessed; optional exact MPF/HEIF/MIAF implementation compliance unassessed.
OS caps and selected codec builds remain proposed.

source_families.family: publication, no-overwrite, cancellation and batch state
source_families.limits: Atomic visibility and durability distinguished; filesystem/platform behavior not executed.

source_families.family: maintained alternatives, release and fixing history
source_families.limits: Historical reports are not prevalence or future build guarantees.
Notices inspected; no chosen package or transitive-license/deployment approval asserted.

plan_dispositions.outcome: revise order/representation with logical geometry and explicit color/alpha
reject decoder-provenance omission; retain digest/preset invalidation
revise denylist; keep role distinction; compare re-encode/fresh output/audit
retain independent publish/success retention; strengthen caps and batch visibility
retain and expand proposed checks; no product execution claimed

criticism_dispositions.final_witness: final geometry/alpha contract: premultiply/filter/unpremultiply; PNG/CSS authority bounds retained
current PNG addition; 2003 source identity remains distinct
JPEG APPn evidence, selected-format inventory and encoded-byte audit
filesystem atomicity qualification and commit-state fallback
patch/revert verified as attributed historical reports; no current-release proof

preservation.meaning: Immutable local originals; selected derivatives and explicit failure
Versioned recipe, dependency identity and finite replay promise
External/internal metadata roles, auxiliary structures and no universal sanitization
Layered limits, mixed outcomes, cancel cleanup and proposed witnesses
Specific ancillary history and optional mechanisms

unassessed_expansion_domains.domain: Every Exif 3.1 tag and serialization exception
unassessed_expansion_domains.reason: Version/index confirmed; full PDF delivery obtained but extraction unavailable. No normative tag-schema completeness claim accepted.

unassessed_expansion_domains.domain: Full MPF 2026 and HEIF/MIAF normative implementation certification
unassessed_expansion_domains.reason: Optional formats remain support gates, not assumed capability.

unassessed_expansion_domains.domain: Installed candidate codecs, actual contributor corpus and display perceptual accuracy
unassessed_expansion_domains.reason: Research proposal; all execution explicitly proposed.

unassessed_expansion_domains.domain: Cold pipeline/product-wide effectiveness, all billing and full behavior provenance
unassessed_expansion_domains.reason: No such inference from this finite FULL source assessment or saved capture.

coverage_definition: COMPLETE means every material stated obligation and consequential claim family was assessed as a finite research planning proposal, not universal format or software correctness.
